findings.issue: fingerprintEvent omits summary, location evidence and semantic signals used by correlation. Changes to reviewed evidence therefore remain applied instead of needs_review.

Union processes Map insertion order instead of prioritizing manual same_event edges. An earlier automatic A-B union plus not_same_event A-C vetoes a valid manual B-C decision while reporting it applied.

follow_up appends a manual edge without replacing the same pair's automatic edge or preventing indirect unions, so automatic same-incident candidates still merge the reports and double-count their relation.

Conflict detection only checks identical pairs. same_event A-B and B-C with not_same_event A-C all report applied even though one required merge is vetoed; the contradictory component must fail closed.
samePatch compares JSON serialization order. Equivalent location patches with reordered keys are falsely marked conflict and neither correction is applied.

Location corrections only reach network nodes/clusters; both deployed UIs and first-paint map data use uncorrected event snapshots. A successfully applied correction therefore leaves the displayed coordinates and location role unchanged.
The dashboard and globe adjacency indexes discard follow-up direction. Viewing the later report labels its earlier neighbor as a follow-up too, with no directional explanation.

summary: Reviewed against issue #44 and fixed seven defects in stale-evidence detection, manual precedence, follow-up replacement/direction, transitive conflicts, patch comparison and displayed location corrections. Nine regression tests have observed red-to-green proof; Git Bash verification passes 877 Vitest tests, 5 Python tests, typecheck/build and operational audits. Local fixes only; no push or deployment.
